q: 在邮局第一次见面，很高兴___你。
zh: 在邮局第一次见面，很高兴认识你。
py: zài yóu jú dì yī cì jiàn miàn hěn gāo xìng rèn shi nǐ
en: We met at the post office for the first time. Nice to meet you.
why: Meeting a person and becoming acquainted is 认识 (很高兴认识你). 知道 only means you know a fact or who someone is, and 了解 means knowing in depth, which a first meeting cannot give.

q: 你___银行在哪儿吗？
zh: 你知道银行在哪儿吗？
py: nǐ zhī dào yín háng zài nǎ r ma
en: Do you know where the bank is?
why: The object is a fact (where the bank is), so 知道. 认识 is for people, characters and roads, and 了解 would mean knowing the bank in depth.

q: 他在中国住了十年，很___中国的节日。
zh: 他在中国住了十年，很了解中国的节日。
py: tā zài zhōng guó zhù le shí nián hěn liǎo jiě zhōng guó de jié rì
en: He has lived in China for ten years and knows Chinese festivals very well.
why: Knowing something in depth, with degree word 很, is 了解. 知道 and 认识 never take 很.

q: 这个汉字我不___，你能读给我听吗？
zh: 这个汉字我不认识，你能读给我听吗？
py: zhè ge hàn zì wǒ bù rèn shi nǐ néng dú gěi wǒ tīng ma
en: I don't recognise this character. Can you read it to me?
why: Recognising a written character is 认识. 了解 means to understand a topic or person in depth and cannot be used for a single character.

q: 他___明天银行不开门，所以今天来取钱了。
zh: 他知道明天银行不开门，所以今天来取钱了。
py: tā zhī dào míng tiān yín háng bù kāi mén suǒ yǐ jīn tiān lái qǔ qián le
en: He knew the bank would be closed tomorrow, so he came to withdraw money today.
why: A clause (the bank will be closed tomorrow) is a fact, so 知道. 认识 takes a person or character, and 了解 would suggest deep knowledge of the matter.

q: 在网上买东西以前，我会先___一下这家店的情况。
zh: 在网上买东西以前，我会先了解一下这家店的情况。
py: zài wǎng shàng mǎi dōng xi yǐ qián wǒ huì xiān liǎo jiě yí xià zhè jiā diàn de qíng kuàng
en: Before shopping online I first find out about the shop.
why: 了解一下 means to look into and get to know a situation. 认识 is for people and 知道一下 is not said; a person cannot 认识 a shop's situation.

q: 小王去年在球场上___了很多朋友。
zh: 小王去年在球场上认识了很多朋友。
py: xiǎo wáng qù nián zài qiú chǎng shàng rèn shi le hěn duō péng you
en: Last year Xiao Wang got to know many friends on the pitch.
why: Meeting people and becoming acquainted with them is 认识了很多朋友. 知道 would only mean knowing who they are, and 了解 means knowing someone in depth, not making new friends.

s: 我很知道这个城市的历史。
s_py: wǒ hěn zhī dào zhè ge chéng shì de lì shǐ
zh: 我很了解这个城市的历史。
py: wǒ hěn liǎo jiě zhè ge chéng shì de lì shǐ
en: I know the history of this city very well.
why: 知道 never takes 很. Knowing a topic well is 了解.

s: 我知道他，可是我们没见过面。
s_py: wǒ zhī dào tā kě shì wǒ men méi jiàn guò miàn
zh: 我知道他，可是我们没见过面。
py: wǒ zhī dào tā kě shì wǒ men méi jiàn guò miàn
en: I know of him, but we have never met.
why: 知道 + person means you know who he is without having met, so the second clause fits. 认识 would contradict 没见过面.

s: 我不认识今天的作业是什么。
s_py: wǒ bù rèn shi jīn tiān de zuò yè shì shén me
zh: 我不知道今天的作业是什么。
py: wǒ bù zhī dào jīn tiān de zuò yè shì shén me
en: I don't know what today's homework is.
why: What the homework is, is a fact, so 知道. 认识 only takes people, characters and roads.

q: 他说话声音太小，我听不___。
zh: 他说话声音太小，我听不清楚。
py: tā shuō huà shēng yīn tài xiǎo wǒ tīng bù qīng chu
en: He speaks so quietly that I can't hear him clearly.
why: A voice that is too quiet is a problem of hearing clearly, so 听不清楚. 听不懂 means you heard but could not grasp the meaning.

q: 我妈妈不___英语，所以我们说中文。
zh: 我妈妈不懂英语，所以我们说中文。
py: wǒ mā ma bù dǒng yīng yǔ suǒ yǐ wǒ men shuō zhōng wén
en: My mum doesn't know English, so we speak Chinese.
why: Knowing a language is 懂 + language. 清楚 means clear and cannot take a language as object.

q: 黑板上的字太小，我看不___。
zh: 黑板上的字太小，我看不清楚。
py: hēi bǎn shàng de zì tài xiǎo wǒ kàn bù qīng chu
en: The writing on the blackboard is too small; I can't see it clearly.
why: Writing that is too small is a problem of seeing clearly: 看不清楚. 看不懂 would mean you could see it but not understand it.

q: 银行的人把办卡的方法说得很___，我一听就会了。
zh: 银行的人把办卡的方法说得很清楚，我一听就会了。
py: yín háng de rén bǎ bàn kǎ de fāng fǎ shuō de hěn qīng chu wǒ yì tīng jiù huì le
en: The bank clerk explained how to get a card so clearly that I got it at once.
why: How clearly someone speaks is 说得很清楚. 懂 is what the listener does and cannot describe the speaking.

q: 这件事的经过我不太___，你去问小王吧。
zh: 这件事的经过我不太清楚，你去问小王吧。
py: zhè jiàn shì de jīng guò wǒ bú tài qīng chu nǐ qù wèn xiǎo wáng ba
en: I'm not very sure how this came about; go and ask Xiao Wang.
why: 不太清楚 means 'not sure of the facts', which fits asking someone else. 懂 is for grasping meaning or a skill, not for knowing the course of events.

q: 我不___日语，所以看不了这本书。
zh: 我不懂日语，所以看不了这本书。
py: wǒ bù dǒng rì yǔ suǒ yǐ kàn bu liǎo zhè běn shū
en: I don't know Japanese, so I can't read this book.
why: Knowing a language is 懂 + language. 清楚 and 明白 cannot take a language as object.

q: 他对这家银行的规定了解得很___，所以大家都爱问他。
zh: 他对这家银行的规定了解得很清楚，所以大家都爱问他。
py: tā duì zhè jiā yín háng de guī dìng liǎo jiě de hěn qīng chu suǒ yǐ dà jiā dōu ài wèn tā
en: He knows the bank's rules inside out, so everyone likes to ask him.
why: 了解得很清楚 means knowing the details clearly. 懂 does not follow 了解得.

s: 老师说得很懂，我们都喜欢听他的课。
s_py: lǎo shī shuō de hěn dǒng wǒ men dōu xǐ huan tīng tā de kè
zh: 老师说得很清楚，我们都喜欢听他的课。
py: lǎo shī shuō de hěn qīng chu wǒ men dōu xǐ huan tīng tā de kè
en: The teacher explains things very clearly, and we all like to listen to his lessons.
why: How clearly someone speaks is 说得很清楚. 懂 describes the listener and cannot follow 说得很.

s: 这张表我看清楚了，可是没看懂。
s_py: zhè zhāng biǎo wǒ kàn qīng chu le kě shì méi kàn dǒng
zh: 这张表我看清楚了，可是没看懂。
py: zhè zhāng biǎo wǒ kàn qīng chu le kě shì méi kàn dǒng
en: I could see this form clearly, but I couldn't make sense of it.
why: 看清楚 is seeing clearly and 看懂 is making sense of it, so the two can be set against each other.

s: 我不清楚法语，所以听不懂。
s_py: wǒ bù qīng chu fǎ yǔ suǒ yǐ tīng bù dǒng
zh: 我不懂法语，所以听不懂。
py: wǒ bù dǒng fǎ yǔ suǒ yǐ tīng bù dǒng
en: I don't know French, so I can't understand it.
why: Knowing a language is 懂 + language. 清楚 cannot take a language as object.

q: 昨天他迟到了，今天___迟到了。
zh: 昨天他迟到了，今天又迟到了。
py: zuó tiān tā chí dào le jīn tiān yòu chí dào le
en: He was late yesterday and was late again today.
why: The repeat has already happened (迟到了), so 又. 再 is for a repeat that has not happened yet.

q: 这本书很好，我想明天___看一遍。
zh: 这本书很好，我想明天再看一遍。
py: zhè běn shū hěn hǎo wǒ xiǎng míng tiān zài kàn yí biàn
en: This book is good; I want to read it again tomorrow.
why: A repeat planned for tomorrow takes 再: 明天再看一遍. 又 is for a repeat that has already happened.

q: 我还没吃饱，想___吃一碗饭。
zh: 我还没吃饱，想再吃一碗饭。
py: wǒ hái méi chī bǎo xiǎng zài chī yì wǎn fàn
en: I'm still hungry; I'd like to eat another bowl of rice.
why: Another bowl you have not eaten yet is a repeat still to come, so 想再吃一碗. 又 would mean the extra bowl has already been eaten.

q: 邮局中午休息，你下午两点___来吧。
zh: 邮局中午休息，你下午两点再来吧。
py: yóu jú zhōng wǔ xiū xi nǐ xià wǔ liǎng diǎn zài lái ba
en: The post office is closed at noon; come back at two in the afternoon.
why: A request about a future return is 再. 又 would need the return to have happened already.

q: 都十点了，他___没起床。
zh: 都十点了，他还没起床。
py: dōu shí diǎn le tā hái méi qǐ chuáng
en: It's already ten o'clock and he still hasn't got up.
why: 还 + 没 means 'still not yet'. 再 cannot stand before 没 to mean 'still'.

q: 上个月他刚去过上海，这个月___去了。
zh: 上个月他刚去过上海，这个月又去了。
py: shàng ge yuè tā gāng qù guò shàng hǎi zhè ge yuè yòu qù le
en: He went to Shanghai last month, and this month he has gone again.
why: The repeat has happened (去了), so 又. 再 would need the second trip to still lie ahead.

q: 雨下了一个上午，现在___在下。
zh: 雨下了一个上午，现在还在下。
py: yǔ xià le yí ge shàng wǔ xiàn zài hái zài xià
en: It has rained all morning and it's still raining now.
why: Something that has not stopped is 还在 + verb, 'still'. 再 is for a repeat that has not happened yet and cannot go before 在 to mean 'still'.

s: 周末我们又去公园玩吧。
s_py: zhōu mò wǒ men yòu qù gōng yuán wán ba
zh: 周末我们再去公园玩吧。
py: zhōu mò wǒ men zài qù gōng yuán wán ba
en: Let's go to the park again at the weekend.
why: A suggestion about the future takes 再. 又 only fits repeats that have already happened.

s: 明天又是星期一了，真不想上班。
s_py: míng tiān yòu shì xīng qī yī le zhēn bù xiǎng shàng bān
zh: 明天又是星期一了，真不想上班。
py: míng tiān yòu shì xīng qī yī le zhēn bù xiǎng shàng bān
en: Tomorrow is Monday again; I really don't want to go to work.
why: 又 can look ahead to a repeat that is certain to come, especially in 又是…了, so this is correct.

s: 对不起，我没听清楚，请你又说一遍。
s_py: duì bu qǐ wǒ méi tīng qīng chu qǐng nǐ yòu shuō yí biàn
zh: 对不起，我没听清楚，请你再说一遍。
py: duì bu qǐ wǒ méi tīng qīng chu qǐng nǐ zài shuō yí biàn
en: Sorry, I didn't hear clearly; please say it again.
why: A request for a repeat still to come is 再说一遍. 又 cannot be used in a request.

q: 下课___，我要去银行。
zh: 下课以后，我要去银行。
py: xià kè yǐ hòu wǒ yào qù yín háng
en: After class I'm going to the bank.
why: 'After X' is clause + 以后. 后来 and 然后 cannot be attached to 下课.

q: 我先去邮局寄信，___去超市买菜。
zh: 我先去邮局寄信，然后去超市买菜。
py: wǒ xiān qù yóu jú jì xìn rán hòu qù chāo shì mǎi cài
en: I'll first post a letter at the post office, then go to the supermarket to buy food.
why: 先…然后… marks the next step in a plan. 后来 only looks back on a past story, and 以后 needs a clause in front of it.

q: 他去年学过画画，___因为太忙就不学了。
zh: 他去年学过画画，后来因为太忙就不学了。
py: tā qù nián xué guò huà huà hòu lái yīn wèi tài máng jiù bù xué le
en: He studied painting last year, but later he was too busy and stopped.
why: 后来 opens a later part of a past story and stands alone. 以后 on its own looks forward ('from now on'), so it cannot carry a past story on.

q: ___我每个月都要存一些钱，不能再乱花了。
zh: 以后我每个月都要存一些钱，不能再乱花了。
py: yǐ hòu wǒ měi ge yuè dōu yào cún yì xiē qián bù néng zài luàn huā le
en: From now on I must save some money every month and stop spending carelessly.
why: 以后 at the start means 'from now on' and looks forward. 后来 only describes the past.

q: 过了春节___，商店里的人就少了。
zh: 过了春节以后，商店里的人就少了。
py: guò le chūn jié yǐ hòu shāng diàn lǐ de rén jiù shǎo le
en: After the Spring Festival there are fewer people in the shops.
why: 'After X' is clause + 以后. 然后 and 后来 cannot be attached to 过了春节.

q: 他们考上不同的大学___，就很少见面了。
zh: 他们考上不同的大学以后，就很少见面了。
py: tā men kǎo shàng bù tóng de dà xué yǐ hòu jiù hěn shǎo jiàn miàn le
en: After they got into different universities they seldom met.
why: Clause + 以后 means 'after X': 考上不同的大学以后. 后来 never attaches to a clause; it stands alone at the start of a later part of a story.

q: 你先把表填好，___交给柜台的工作人员。
zh: 你先把表填好，然后交给柜台的工作人员。
py: nǐ xiān bǎ biǎo tián hǎo rán hòu jiāo gěi guì tái de gōng zuò rén yuán
en: First fill in the form, then hand it to the staff at the counter.
why: 先…然后… gives the next step of an instruction. 后来 is for past stories only, and 以后 needs a clause in front of it.

s: 下课后来，我们去打篮球吧。
s_py: xià kè hòu lái wǒ men qù dǎ lán qiú ba
zh: 下课以后，我们去打篮球吧。
py: xià kè yǐ hòu wǒ men qù dǎ lán qiú ba
en: After class let's go and play basketball.
why: 'After class' is 下课以后. 后来 cannot follow a clause and never looks to the future.

s: 他小时候在上海住过，后来搬到了北京。
s_py: tā xiǎo shí hou zài shàng hǎi zhù guò hòu lái bān dào le běi jīng
zh: 他小时候在上海住过，后来搬到了北京。
py: tā xiǎo shí hou zài shàng hǎi zhù guò hòu lái bān dào le běi jīng
en: He lived in Shanghai as a child and later moved to Beijing.
why: 后来 stands alone at the start of the second clause of a past story, which is exactly its use.

s: 以后你要多锻炼身体。
s_py: yǐ hòu nǐ yào duō duàn liàn shēn tǐ
zh: 以后你要多锻炼身体。
py: yǐ hòu nǐ yào duō duàn liàn shēn tǐ
en: From now on you should exercise more.
why: 以后 alone at the start means 'from now on' and is correct for advice about the future.

q: 我小___，家在上海。
zh: 我小的时候，家在上海。
py: wǒ xiǎo de shí hou jiā zài shàng hǎi
en: When I was little, my home was in Shanghai.
why: 'When I was little' is 我小的时候. 以前 cannot follow 小 to mean 'when'.

q: 开车___不能打电话。
zh: 开车时不能打电话。
py: kāi chē shí bù néng dǎ diàn huà
en: You must not use the phone while driving.
why: 'While driving' is clause + 时 (the written form of 的时候). 以前 would mean 'before driving'.

q: 他在看电视___，妈妈在厨房做饭。
zh: 他在看电视的时候，妈妈在厨房做饭。
py: tā zài kàn diàn shì de shí hou mā ma zài chú fáng zuò fàn
en: While he was watching TV, mum was cooking in the kitchen.
why: Two things going on at the same time: clause + 的时候. 以前 means 'before' and does not fit 在看电视.

q: 考试结束___，我们才能离开教室。
zh: 考试结束以后，我们才能离开教室。
py: kǎo shì jié shù yǐ hòu wǒ men cái néng lí kāi jiào shì
en: We may only leave the classroom after the exam is over.
why: 才 marks the earliest moment allowed, which is after the exam ends: 以后. 以前 would say we may not leave before it ends, with no 才.

q: 我喜欢在睡觉___看一会儿书。
zh: 我喜欢在睡觉以前看一会儿书。
py: wǒ xǐ huan zài shuì jiào yǐ qián kàn yí huì r shū
en: I like to read for a while before going to sleep.
why: Reading before sleep is 睡觉以前. 睡觉以后 would mean after falling asleep, which cannot be done.

q: 我还在上大学___，妈妈每个月都会给我寄一些钱。
zh: 我还在上大学的时候，妈妈每个月都会给我寄一些钱。
py: wǒ hái zài shàng dà xué de shí hou mā ma měi ge yuè dōu huì gěi wǒ jì yì xiē qián
en: When I was still at university, my mum sent me some money every month.
why: 'When' is clause + 的时候. 以前 means 'before' and does not combine with 还在上大学.

q: 我___不喜欢喝咖啡，现在每天都喝。
zh: 我以前不喜欢喝咖啡，现在每天都喝。
py: wǒ yǐ qián bù xǐ huan hē kā fēi xiàn zài měi tiān dōu hē
en: I didn't use to like coffee, but now I drink it every day.
why: 以前 alone means 'in the past', contrasted with 现在. 以后 looks forward, and 的时候 needs a clause.

s: 我小以前住在上海。
s_py: wǒ xiǎo yǐ qián zhù zài shàng hǎi
zh: 我小的时候住在上海。
py: wǒ xiǎo de shí hou zhù zài shàng hǎi
en: When I was little I lived in Shanghai.
why: 'When I was little' is 我小的时候. 以前 means 'before' and cannot follow 小.

s: 下班时，银行门口有很多人。
s_py: xià bān shí yín háng mén kǒu yǒu hěn duō rén
zh: 下班时，银行门口有很多人。
py: xià bān shí yín háng mén kǒu yǒu hěn duō rén
en: When people finish work, there are lots of people at the bank's door.
why: 时 is the written form of 的时候 and attaches straight to the verb phrase, with the time clause first.

s: 我以前不会游泳，现在每个星期都去游泳。
s_py: wǒ yǐ qián bú huì yóu yǒng xiàn zài měi ge xīng qī dōu qù yóu yǒng
zh: 我以前不会游泳，现在每个星期都去游泳。
py: wǒ yǐ qián bú huì yóu yǒng xiàn zài měi ge xīng qī dōu qù yóu yǒng
en: I couldn't swim before, but now I go swimming every week.
why: 以前 alone means 'in the past' and sits after the subject; it is correct here.

q: 你能___我拿一下行李吗？
zh: 你能帮我拿一下行李吗？
py: nǐ néng bāng wǒ ná yí xià xíng li ma
en: Could you hold my luggage for me for a moment?
why: 帮 + person + verb is everyday help. 帮忙 already contains its object 忙 and cannot take 我.

q: 请你___个忙，好吗？
zh: 请你帮个忙，好吗？
py: qǐng nǐ bāng ge máng hǎo ma
en: Could you do me a favour?
why: 帮个忙 uses 帮 with the object 忙 split off. 帮助 and 帮忙 cannot be followed by another 忙.

q: 谢谢你的___，我一个人真的做不完。
zh: 谢谢你的帮助，我一个人真的做不完。
py: xiè xie nǐ de bāng zhù wǒ yí ge rén zhēn de zuò bu wán
en: Thank you for your help; I really couldn't finish by myself.
why: After 你的 a noun is needed, and 帮助 is also the noun 'help'. 帮 is only a verb.

q: 周末我去朋友家___，他要搬家。
zh: 周末我去朋友家帮忙，他要搬家。
py: zhōu mò wǒ qù péng you jiā bāng máng tā yào bān jiā
en: At the weekend I'm going to my friend's place to help, as he's moving house.
why: With no person object, 帮忙 stands whole as 'lend a hand'. 帮助 needs an object.

q: 邮局的人___我把包裹寄到了上海。
zh: 邮局的人帮我把包裹寄到了上海。
py: yóu jú de rén bāng wǒ bǎ bāo guǒ jì dào le shàng hǎi
en: The post office clerk helped me send the parcel to Shanghai.
why: 帮 + person + verb phrase. 帮忙 cannot take 我 as an object.

q: 老师常常___学习不好的同学。
zh: 老师常常帮助学习不好的同学。
py: lǎo shī cháng cháng bāng zhù xué xí bù hǎo de tóng xué
en: The teacher often helps students who do badly in their studies.
why: 帮助 takes a person as direct object. 帮忙 never takes an object.

q: 他在银行工作，上个星期帮了我一个很大的___。
zh: 他在银行工作，上个星期帮了我一个很大的忙。
py: tā zài yín háng gōng zuò shàng ge xīng qī bāng le wǒ yí ge hěn dà de máng
en: He works at a bank and last week did me a big favour.
why: 帮忙 is verb + object, so it splits: 帮了我一个很大的忙. 帮忙 or 帮助 cannot fill the object slot after 一个很大的.

s: 我帮忙你找钱包。
s_py: wǒ bāng máng nǐ zhǎo qián bāo
zh: 我帮你找钱包。
py: wǒ bāng nǐ zhǎo qián bāo
en: I'll help you look for your wallet.
why: 帮忙 already has its object 忙 and cannot take 你. Say 帮你找 or 帮你的忙.

s: 同学们都愿意帮助他。
s_py: tóng xué men dōu yuàn yì bāng zhù tā
zh: 同学们都愿意帮助他。
py: tóng xué men dōu yuàn yì bāng zhù tā
en: All the classmates are willing to help him.
why: 帮助 takes a person as direct object, so 帮助他 is correct.

s: 谢谢你的帮，我很高兴。
s_py: xiè xie nǐ de bāng wǒ hěn gāo xìng
zh: 谢谢你的帮助，我很高兴。
py: xiè xie nǐ de bāng zhù wǒ hěn gāo xìng
en: Thank you for your help; I'm very glad.
why: After 你的 a noun is needed. 帮 is only a verb; the noun is 帮助.

q: 我___你不会来了，原来你在这儿。
zh: 我以为你不会来了，原来你在这儿。
py: wǒ yǐ wéi nǐ bú huì lái le yuán lái nǐ zài zhè r
en: I thought you weren't coming, but you're here.
why: 原来 shows the belief was wrong, so 以为. 认为 states a considered view that the speaker still holds and does not fit a reversal.

q: 跑了一个小时，我___很累。
zh: 跑了一个小时，我觉得很累。
py: pǎo le yí ge xiǎo shí wǒ jué de hěn lèi
en: After running for an hour I feel very tired.
why: A bodily feeling is 觉得. 认为 is never used for body feelings, and 以为 means a mistaken belief.

q: 喝了这杯热茶，我___舒服多了。
zh: 喝了这杯热茶，我觉得舒服多了。
py: hē le zhè bēi rè chá wǒ jué de shū fu duō le
en: After this cup of hot tea I feel much better.
why: A bodily feeling is 觉得. 认为 does not express how you feel physically.

q: 你___这件衣服怎么样？
zh: 你觉得这件衣服怎么样？
py: nǐ jué de zhè jiàn yī fu zěn me yàng
en: What do you think of this top?
why: Asking for an opinion is 你觉得…怎么样. 以为 means a belief that turned out false.

q: 我___小王是学生，原来他是体育老师。
zh: 我以为小王是学生，原来他是体育老师。
py: wǒ yǐ wéi xiǎo wáng shì xué sheng yuán lái tā shì tǐ yù lǎo shī
en: I thought Xiao Wang was a student, but he's actually the PE teacher.
why: 原来 reveals that the belief was false, so 以为. 认为 is a considered judgement you still hold and clashes with 原来.

q: 很多专家___，每天运动半个小时对身体最好。
zh: 很多专家认为，每天运动半个小时对身体最好。
py: hěn duō zhuān jiā rèn wéi měi tiān yùn dòng bàn ge xiǎo shí duì shēn tǐ zuì hǎo
en: Many experts think that half an hour of exercise a day is best for the body.
why: An expert's considered judgement is 认为. 以为 would say they were wrong.

q: 我___这双球鞋要两千块，原来只要两百块。
zh: 我以为这双球鞋要两千块，原来只要两百块。
py: wǒ yǐ wéi zhè shuāng qiú xié yào liǎng qiān kuài yuán lái zhǐ yào liǎng bǎi kuài
en: I thought these trainers cost two thousand yuan, but they cost only two hundred.
why: 原来 shows the guess was wrong, so 以为. 认为 states a judgement you still hold and does not fit a reversal.

s: 我认为很饿，我们去吃饭吧。
s_py: wǒ rèn wéi hěn è wǒ men qù chī fàn ba
zh: 我觉得很饿，我们去吃饭吧。
py: wǒ jué de hěn è wǒ men qù chī fàn ba
en: I feel very hungry; let's go and eat.
why: A bodily feeling is 觉得. 认为 is never used for feeling hungry.

s: 我以为今天有课，其实没有。
s_py: wǒ yǐ wéi jīn tiān yǒu kè qí shí méi yǒu
zh: 我以为今天有课，其实没有。
py: wǒ yǐ wéi jīn tiān yǒu kè qí shí méi yǒu
en: I thought there was a class today, but there isn't.
why: 以为 is right because 其实 shows the belief was wrong.

s: 我认为你已经回家了，原来你还在学校。
s_py: wǒ rèn wéi nǐ yǐ jīng huí jiā le yuán lái nǐ hái zài xué xiào
zh: 我以为你已经回家了，原来你还在学校。
py: wǒ yǐ wéi nǐ yǐ jīng huí jiā le yuán lái nǐ hái zài xué xiào
en: I thought you'd already gone home, but you're still at school.
why: 原来 shows the belief was false, so it must be 以为. 认为 states a view you still hold.

q: 周末我想去医院___奶奶。
zh: 周末我想去医院看望奶奶。
py: zhōu mò wǒ xiǎng qù yī yuàn kàn wàng nǎi nai
en: At the weekend I want to go to the hospital to see grandma.
why: A person you care about is visited with 看望. 参观 is for places, and 访问 is an official visit.

q: 我们明天去博物馆___。
zh: 我们明天去博物馆参观。
py: wǒ men míng tiān qù bó wù guǎn cān guān
en: We're going to look round the museum tomorrow.
why: A museum is a place you look round: 参观. 看望 is for people and 访问 is official.

q: 暑假我们去海南___。
zh: 暑假我们去海南旅游。
py: shǔ jià wǒ men qù hǎi nán lǚ yóu
en: In the summer holiday we're going to Hainan for a holiday.
why: 去 + place + 旅游 is going somewhere on holiday. 参观 is for looking round one site such as a museum or factory, not a holiday in a whole province, and 看望 needs a person.

q: 老师带我们去工厂___，看看工人怎么工作。
zh: 老师带我们去工厂参观，看看工人怎么工作。
py: lǎo shī dài wǒ men qù gōng chǎng cān guān kàn kan gōng rén zěn me gōng zuò
en: The teacher took us to look round a factory and see how the workers work.
why: Looking round a factory is 参观. 看望 is only for visiting people.

q: 小李病了，下班以后我们一起去___他吧。
zh: 小李病了，下班以后我们一起去看望他吧。
py: xiǎo lǐ bìng le xià bān yǐ hòu wǒ men yì qǐ qù kàn wàng tā ba
en: Xiao Li is ill; let's go and see him after work.
why: A sick friend is visited with 看望. 参观 is for places, 访问 is official.

q: 你可以___这个网站，上面有很多旅游信息。
zh: 你可以访问这个网站，上面有很多旅游信息。
py: nǐ kě yǐ fǎng wèn zhè ge wǎng zhàn shàng miàn yǒu hěn duō lǚ yóu xìn xī
en: You can visit this website; it has lots of travel information.
why: Going to a website is 访问. 看望 is only for people.

q: 中国的李教授下个月要去法国___，和那里的大学交流。
zh: 中国的李教授下个月要去法国访问，和那里的大学交流。
py: zhōng guó de lǐ jiào shòu xià ge yuè yào qù fǎ guó fǎng wèn hé nà lǐ de dà xué jiāo liú
en: Professor Li from China will go on an official visit to France next month to exchange ideas with universities there.
why: An official visit to a country is 访问. 看望 is for relatives and friends.

s: 春节我要去参观我的外婆。
s_py: chūn jié wǒ yào qù cān guān wǒ de wài pó
zh: 春节我要去看望我的外婆。
py: chūn jié wǒ yào qù kàn wàng wǒ de wài pó
en: At the Spring Festival I'm going to see my grandmother.
why: A person is visited with 看望. 参观 is for places you look round.

s: 我们暑假去北京旅游了一个星期。
s_py: wǒ men shǔ jià qù běi jīng lǚ yóu le yí ge xīng qī
zh: 我们暑假去北京旅游了一个星期。
py: wǒ men shǔ jià qù běi jīng lǚ yóu le yí ge xīng qī
en: We spent a week on holiday in Beijing in the summer.
why: 去 + place + 旅游 is the correct pattern; the place comes after 去.

s: 去年国庆节我们旅游了上海。
s_py: qù nián guó qìng jié wǒ men lǚ yóu le shàng hǎi
zh: 去年国庆节我们去上海旅游了。
py: qù nián guó qìng jié wǒ men qù shàng hǎi lǚ yóu le
en: Last National Day we went to Shanghai on holiday.
why: 旅游 takes no place object. The place goes after 去: 去上海旅游.

q: 这双鞋我穿太大了，不___。
zh: 这双鞋我穿太大了，不合适。
py: zhè shuāng xié wǒ chuān tài dà le bù hé shì
en: These shoes are too big for me; they don't fit properly.
why: With no object after it the adjective 合适 is needed. 适合 is a verb and must be followed by an object.

q: 这件红衣服很___你。
zh: 这件红衣服很适合你。
py: zhè jiàn hóng yī fu hěn shì hé nǐ
en: This red top really suits you.
why: An object (你) follows, so the verb 适合. 合适 is an adjective and cannot take an object.

q: 这条裤子大小正___，我就买这条吧。
zh: 这条裤子大小正合适，我就买这条吧。
py: zhè tiáo kù zi dà xiǎo zhèng hé shì wǒ jiù mǎi zhè tiáo ba
en: These trousers are just the right size, so I'll take them.
why: 正合适 'just right' uses the adjective, with nothing after it. 适合 is a verb and needs an object, as in 正适合你.

q: 这个消息来得太___了，我们都没有准备。
zh: 这个消息来得太突然了，我们都没有准备。
py: zhè ge xiāo xi lái de tài tū rán le wǒ men dōu méi yǒu zhǔn bèi
en: This news came so suddenly that none of us was prepared.
why: 太…了 needs an adjective, and only 突然 is also an adjective. 忽然 is only an adverb.

q: 他做了二十年老师，教学很有___。
zh: 他做了二十年老师，教学很有经验。
py: tā zuò le èr shí nián lǎo shī jiào xué hěn yǒu jīng yàn
en: He has been a teacher for twenty years and has a lot of teaching experience.
why: Know-how built up by doing is 经验. 经历 is what you went through, not skill.

q: 他年轻的时候___过很多困难，所以特别能吃苦。
zh: 他年轻的时候经历过很多困难，所以特别能吃苦。
py: tā nián qīng de shí hou jīng lì guò hěn duō kùn nan suǒ yǐ tè bié néng chī kǔ
en: He went through a lot of hardship when he was young, so he can endure a great deal.
why: 'Go through' is the verb 经历. 经验 is only a noun and cannot take 过.

q: 这次出国旅行是一次难忘的___。
zh: 这次出国旅行是一次难忘的经历。
py: zhè cì chū guó lǚ xíng shì yí cì nán wàng de jīng lì
en: This trip abroad was an unforgettable experience.
why: Something that happened to you is an 经历: 一次难忘的经历. In mainland usage 经验 is the know-how you gain, not the event itself.

s: 这个颜色不太合适我。
s_py: zhè ge yán sè bú tài hé shì wǒ
zh: 这个颜色不太适合我。
py: zhè ge yán sè bú tài shì hé wǒ
en: This colour doesn't really suit me.
why: 合适 is an adjective and takes no object. With 我 after it you need 适合.

s: 这个手机的价格对学生很合适。
s_py: zhè ge shǒu jī de jià gé duì xué sheng hěn hé shì
zh: 这个手机的价格对学生很合适。
py: zhè ge shǒu jī de jià gé duì xué sheng hěn hé shì
en: The price of this phone is just right for students.
why: 合适 stands without an object here, with 对学生 before it, so the adjective is correct.

s: 这件事太忽然了，我们都没想到。
s_py: zhè jiàn shì tài hū rán le wǒ men dōu méi xiǎng dào
zh: 这件事太突然了，我们都没想到。
py: zhè jiàn shì tài tū rán le wǒ men dōu méi xiǎng dào
en: This is so sudden; none of us expected it.
why: 太…了 needs an adjective. 突然 can be an adjective; 忽然 is only an adverb before verbs.

q: 我___钱包不见了。
zh: 我发现钱包不见了。
py: wǒ fā xiàn qián bāo bú jiàn le
en: I found that my wallet was missing.
why: Noticing something that is already the case is 发现. 发明 is making something new.

q: 这是一本___中国节日的书。
zh: 这是一本关于中国节日的书。
py: zhè shì yì běn guān yú zhōng guó jié rì de shū
en: This is a book about Chinese festivals.
why: A topic before 的 + noun is introduced by 关于. 对于 means 'towards, as for'.

q: ___我来说，汉字比语法难。
zh: 对于我来说，汉字比语法难。
py: duì yú wǒ lái shuō hàn zì bǐ yǔ fǎ nán
en: For me, characters are harder than grammar.
why: 'As for me' is 对于…来说. 关于 only names a topic and does not pair with 来说.

q: 我每天去学校都___一家邮局。
zh: 我每天去学校都经过一家邮局。
py: wǒ měi tiān qù xué xiào dōu jīng guò yì jiā yóu jú
en: Every day on my way to school I pass a post office.
why: Going past a place on the way is 经过. 通过 means by means of or passing a test.

q: 他没有___这次汉语考试，还要再考一次。
zh: 他没有通过这次汉语考试，还要再考一次。
py: tā méi yǒu tōng guò zhè cì hàn yǔ kǎo shì hái yào zài kǎo yí cì
en: He didn't pass this Chinese exam and has to take it again.
why: Passing a test is 通过. 经过 means going past a place or going through a process.

q: ___看电视，我们可以了解到很多中国的文化。
zh: 通过看电视，我们可以了解到很多中国的文化。
py: tōng guò kàn diàn shì wǒ men kě yǐ liǎo jiě dào hěn duō zhōng guó de wén huà
en: By watching TV we can learn a lot about Chinese culture.
why: 'By means of watching TV' is 通过. 经过 is for going past a place or through a process.

q: 这台机器是小王的爸爸自己___的，商店里买不到。
zh: 这台机器是小王的爸爸自己发明的，商店里买不到。
py: zhè tái jī qì shì xiǎo wáng de bà ba zì jǐ fā míng de shāng diàn lǐ mǎi bu dào
en: This machine was invented by Xiao Wang's father himself; you can't buy it in the shops.
why: Creating something new is 发明. 发现 means finding what already exists.

s: 关于我来说，运动很重要。
s_py: guān yú wǒ lái shuō yùn dòng hěn zhòng yào
zh: 对于我来说，运动很重要。
py: duì yú wǒ lái shuō yùn dòng hěn zhòng yào
en: For me, exercise is very important.
why: 'As for me' is 对于…来说. 关于 only introduces a topic.

s: 这是一部关于春节的电影。
s_py: zhè shì yí bù guān yú chūn jié de diàn yǐng
zh: 这是一部关于春节的电影。
py: zhè shì yí bù guān yú chūn jié de diàn yǐng
en: This is a film about the Spring Festival.
why: 关于 + topic + 的 + noun is the standard way to say 'about'.

s: 我每天上班都通过那家银行。
s_py: wǒ měi tiān shàng bān dōu tōng guò nà jiā yín háng
zh: 我每天上班都经过那家银行。
py: wǒ měi tiān shàng bān dōu jīng guò nà jiā yín háng
en: I pass that bank every day on my way to work.
why: Going past a building is 经过. 通过 means by means of or passing a test.
